full_prompt_en: This is a square, grainy black-and-white cinematic photograph of a stern adult warrior in layered armor before a crowded line of soldiers. The foremost man fills the center and lower half of the frame from the chest upward. A thick cloth head wrap rises above his brow, and a heavy textured cloak lies over his right shoulder. Beneath it, rows of dark armor plates and cords form a dense patterned surface across his chest. He turns slightly toward the left of the image and looks past the camera with an unwavering expression. His broad face catches pale light on the forehead, nose, and cheek, while the side of the jaw remains dark. Behind him, several helmeted figures press close together. Faces appear at the left and between the shoulders, but the rear ranks become increasingly soft and shadowed. Long narrow poles or weapons rise into the pale upper background, giving the group a restless vertical rhythm without revealing an open landscape. A strong overcast light from above illuminates the leading face and lighter gaps, while black folds, armor recesses, and overlapping helmets create compact shadows. Grain and rough surface texture give the scene a weathered, documentary weight. The shallow depth keeps the nearest face clear and lets the crowd recede into a dark mass. The framing cuts off bodies and leaves little empty space, increasing the sense of pressure and scale. No text appears. The overall composition is severe and crowded, using a single resolute expression, layered silhouettes, and high-contrast monochrome to suggest a larger conflict beyond the frame.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形、颗粒明显的黑白电影式照片，一名神情严峻的成年武士身着层叠铠甲，站在密集士兵队列前。最前方的男子从胸部以上填满中央和下半部。厚布头巾高于眉毛，厚重有肌理的披肩覆在右肩。其下，成排深色甲片和绳带在胸前形成浓密纹样。他略向画面左侧转身，以毫不动摇的神情看向镜头外。宽阔面庞的额头、鼻子和脸颊接到浅色光，颌侧则保持昏暗。身后，多名戴盔人物紧挨在一起。左边和肩间有面孔露出，但后排越来越柔和、越来越暗。细长的杆状物或武器伸入上方浅色背景，使队伍具有不安的竖向节奏，却没有显出开阔风景。来自上方的强阴天光照亮前方面孔和较浅间隙，黑色衣褶、盔甲凹处和相叠头盔形成紧密阴影。颗粒与粗糙表面肌理赋予场景风化般的纪实重量。浅景深保留最近的面容清楚，使人群退成深色团块。取景截断身体，几乎不留空，增强压迫与规模感。没有文字。整体构图严厉而拥挤，以一道坚定神情、层叠剪影和高反差单色暗示画框之外更大的冲突。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome cinematic treatment relies on grain, hard facial modeling, and dense overlap rather than polished spectacle. Silvery light from above finds selected upper planes; deep blacks collect under folds and between repeated forms. A clear near focal area gives way to softer, darker layers behind it, creating depth inside a crowded frame. Vertical linear accents punctuate broad irregular masses, while textured surfaces make midgray areas active. The crop is close, and the edges interrupt forms instead of enclosing a tidy group. Contrast is strong but varied through film-like grain and haze. The overall effect is forceful, weathered, and collective, with one bright focal plane emerging from a heavy surrounding rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色电影式处理依靠颗粒、强烈的面部塑形和浓密重叠，而非光滑的奇观效果。来自上方的银灰光寻找选择性的上表面；浓黑聚在褶皱下和重复形体之间。清楚的近处焦点逐渐转为后方更柔、更暗的层次，在拥挤画框内建立纵深。竖向线性强调穿插于宽阔不规则色块，中灰表面因肌理而活跃。裁切贴近，画边中断形体，而非整齐地包住一组对象。反差强烈，却通过胶片般的颗粒与薄雾产生变化。整体效果有力、风化且富于群体感，一块明亮焦点平面从周围沉重节奏中显现。
theme_en: A stern warrior in layered armor standing before a crowded line of soldiers
theme_zh: 一名神情严峻、身着层叠铠甲的武士站在密集士兵前
name: Akira Kurosawa
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
